applicability: FFT/DFT frequency-resolution planning check for a planned instrument acquisition record length
assumptions: a plain rectangular window (no windowing function applied) for the resolution calculation
the actual sample rate matches the declared nominal value with negligible drift
uncertainty: Standard, foundational DSP time/frequency-resolution relationship; hand-verified before use (fs=48000 Hz, N=4096 -> delta_f=11.71875 Hz; 1 Hz target needs a 1 s record).
limits_policy: A planned record too short for the target resolution is flagged rather than run.
